effects: Pulls exactly `assets` USDC from the signer into the vault, which spends the signer's USDC allowance to the vault (ERC4626._deposit safeTransferFrom).
Mints steakUSDC shares to `receiver`. The share count is computed from vault totals after fee accrual (deposit: _convertToSharesWithTotals, Floor), and there is no minimum.
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho Blue markets and mints performance-fee shares to the fee recipient. Neither moves the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Deposit: 1 USDC deposit amount, share ticker steakUSDC, and the shares' recipient address.

findings.title: deposit: number of steakUSDC shares received is not shown and has no minimum in calldata.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Floor). Case 0: signer received 0.975656792564981956 steakUSDC, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: steakUSDC'.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. A label like 'Receive steakUSDC shares (amount set by vault rate)' would set expectations.

findings.title: deposit: intent 'Deposit' names neither the asset, the amount nor the vault, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit intent "Deposit", interpolatedIntent absent. The 'Share ticker' raw constant field stands alone.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} into steakUSDC vault for shares to {receiver}".

cases.notes: USDC out 1 is shown exactly. The steakUSDC received is shown by ticker and recipient but has no amount, so the reader was unsure of the share count.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Sends exactly `assets` USDC from the vault to `receiver` (after pulling liquidity from Morpho Blue).
Burns steakUSDC shares from `owner`. The count is computed from vault totals, rounded up, and has no maximum in calldata.
When the caller is not `owner`, it spends the caller's share allowance from `owner` (ERC4626._withdraw _spendAllowance).
formats.shown: Withdraw: exactly 11.027134 USDC, to the receiver address, from the owner address.

findings.title: withdraw: number of steakUSDC shares burned from the owner is not shown and has no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Ceil). Case 1: signer burned 10.732385554483293792 steakUSDC, and no field shows shares.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. Labelling 'Owner' as 'Burn shares from' would at least say shares leave that account.

findings.title: withdraw: intent 'Withdraw' omits the asset and vault, and the 'Owner' label does not say shares are burned from it.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json withdraw intent "Withdraw", field label "Owner". There is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} from steakUSDC vault to {receiver}" and relabel owner "Shares burned from".

cases.notes: USDC in 11.027134 is shown exactly. The steakUSDC shares burned appear only as 'Owner', with no amount, and the reader knew the share count was not shown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` steakUSDC from `owner`. When the caller is not owner, it spends the caller's share allowance.
Sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount is computed from vault totals after fee accrual (Floor), with no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem: 11.67648580452523931 steakUSDC shares, to the receiver address, from the owner address.

findings.title: redeem: the asset received (USDC) is named nowhere on the screen. The reader only guessed it.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem fields: shares, receiver, owner only. metadata.constants.underlyingTicker 'USDC' is unused here. Case 2: signer received 12.000052 USDC, and the reader wrote 'presumably USDC... screen doesn't say'.
findings.fix: Add a field {label:'Receive asset', value:'$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker', format:'raw'} or interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".

findings.title: redeem: USDC amount received is not shown and the function has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Floor). Case 2: 12.000052 USDC arrived, and no field shows it.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. A label could state the amount is set by the vault exchange rate.

cases.notes: Shares out are shown exactly. The USDC in has neither its asset nor its amount on screen; the reader assumed USDC.
